prompt:
Our developer workstation has a Niri compositor session running with all applications piled up on workspace 1. We have a workspace assignment policy at `config/policies/workspace_policy.json` that defines which applications should live on which named workspaces (web, code, media, terminal). Your job is to read that policy, then reorganize ALL currently open windows to their correct workspaces according to it. Applications not mentioned in the policy should be left exactly where they are.

When you're done, produce a file called `workspace_audit.json` in the workspace root that captures the window layout both before and after your reorganization.
